To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the double-stacked channel structure of the nitrogen-doped amporphous oxide semiconductor thin-film transistors with the a-IZON/a-IGZON structure is effective in enhancing the field-effect mobility and suppressing the threshold voltage shift.

nitrogen doping of a-IGZO and a-IZO thin films can improve their field effect mobility and stability, and the double-stacked channel structure of a-IZO/N and a-IGZO/N is effective in improving the performance and stability of amorphous oxide TFTs.

the nitrogen-doped amorphic oxide semiconductor thin film transistors (AOS TFTs) with the double-stacked channel layer (DSCL) structures showed the improved electrical performance, and the nitrogen-doped InZnO and indium gallium zinc oxide (IZO/IGZO) heterostructure TFTs showed the superior electrical characteristics to those of the IZO/IGZO and IZGON/IZO TFTs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the nitrogen-doped amorphic oxide semiconductors with DSCL structure and the electrical properties of the corresponding TFT devices.
the nitrogen doping effect on the amorphous oxide thin film transistor (TFT) performance and its mechanism.

the fabrication and characterization of the nitrogen-doped amophous oxide TFTs with the DSCL structure and the results suggest that they are promising for the application in the next-generation flexible displays.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the nitrogen-doping and hetero-structure of the channel layers in the DSCL TFTs are effective to improve the electrical and stability performances.
the DSCL structure is a very promising candidate to achieve the high performance and stability of the AOS TFTs.

the nitrogen-doped amporphous oxide semiconductor thin-film transistors with double-stacked nitrogen-doped channel layers can achieve the better electrical characteristics than the conventional nitrogen-doped amorpous oxide thin-film transisotrs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the nitrogen-doped AOS TFTs with DSCL structure can be used for the high-performance and high-stable backplane devices of the active-matrix organic light-emitting diodes.
the nitrogen-doping and the DSCL structure were both effective in improving the performance of the AOS-TFTs.
the nitrogen-doped AOS TFTs with DSCL structure could be a promising candidate for the future flexible and large-area electronics applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the nitrogen-doping of amorphous oxide films is a promising method for the development of high-performance and high-stable AOS TFTs.
the nitrogen-doped a-IGZO/a-IZO DSCL TFTs are promising candidates for future high-performance and low-cost flexible electronics.
the nitrogen-doped a-IZO/a-IGZO TFTs with double-stacked channels are promising for high-performance and low-cost flexible electronics.
